name: FBT Swap — preview
_comment: WHY THIS FILE EXISTS (2026-11-11): the owner has no foreign card and no phone, and every free container host answered with a payment form (Render, Hugging Face, Koyeb). Vercel is paused. The Arena sandbox preview is not an option either — its id changes every turn, so any URL printed in one turn is dead by the time it is clicked ('502 Sandbox not found'). A Codespace is the one durable, card-free, install-free way to LOOK at the site while fixing its appearance. This file makes it ZERO-COMMAND: Node 22, dependencies on creation, the dev server started on every boot (start-dev.sh), and port 5173 opened in the editor's preview pane automatically. The matching Vite change is `.app.github.dev` in server.allowedHosts — without it the forwarded host is refused with an opaque 403. NOT a deployment: this runs `npm run dev`; the production image is built by ci/docker-image.yml.
